zsb-marketplace/catalog.js.reason: Catalog and release assets are limited to the configured GitHub repo and allowed GitHub hosts.

zsb-marketplace/hub.js.reason: Uses the exact Hub desktop panel bridge and the installed Hub ZIP parser.

zsb-marketplace/index.js.reason: Uses Electron for the Hub panel bridge and fetch for the validated catalog and ZIP downloads.

daily-reports/index.js.reason: Reads saved counters from a fixed list of sibling plugin JSON files.

auction-sniper/cco-price-data.js.reason: Downloads the public ChunkyCheese PriceData CSV from a fixed Google Sheets URL. Sends no account data.

farm-value/cco-price-data.js.reason: Downloads the public ChunkyCheese PriceData CSV from a fixed Google Sheets URL. Sends no account data.

farm-value/desktop-chart.js.reason: Mounts the local history chart only in the installed Hub desktop panel using serialized numeric samples.

zsb-account-setup/bridge.js.reason: Runs the optional pairing bridge on 127.0.0.1 with a random bearer secret and four fixed commands.

zsb-account-setup/index.js.reason: Uses Electron, the installed Hub host and transport modules, and checks clipboard links against the official verification endpoint.

zsb-account-setup/routed-session.js.reason: Uses the selected routed Chromium session for Case Clicker and reads the login token only from the signup window on that origin to hand the account to Hub.
